note: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-01 (ROCmDoc round-2 remediation): this full-set transformers/bf16 result (Overall 94.05) was imported while its reproduction-critical run_spec identity hashes were still 'unknown' (model.model_revision, model.weights_sha256, benchmark.page_set_hash, and all inference.* hashes).
